start.dialog: An Inferno Wyrm has been spotted near the Magma Flats! These dragons shed scales that are worth a fortune to smiths. But the beast is territorial and dangerous. If you're brave enough to sneak close and grab a fallen scale... well, the reward would be substantial!
start.objective: Find and retrieve a shed scale from the Inferno Wyrm's territory

progress.dialog: You found a scale! But the Wyrm noticed you! Quick, escape its territory without fighting—it would destroy you! Use the steam vents for cover and run!
progress.objective: Escape the Inferno Wyrm's territory without being caught

complete.dialog: You actually got one! And lived! This scale will make armor that could withstand dragonfire! Here's your payment—and I've arranged for a master smith to craft you Wyrmscale Boots for free!

party_comments.kade: I looked that dragon in the eye and lived to tell about it!
party_comments.twist: My heart is still pounding. That was too close!
party_comments.nix7: Dragon threat assessment: maximum. Evasion protocol: successful.
